related_questions.question: Will a torn bicep heal on its own?
related_questions.snippet: A torn bicep tendon will not heal on its own – that's why it is so important to see your doctor as soon as you can if you are in pain. Contact Specialty Orthopaedics in Harrison, New York, if your arm (or any other part of your body!) is in pain.

text_blocks.snippet: A torn bicep can cause a range of symptoms, including sudden, sharp pain in the upper arm or elbow, a popping or snapping sound at the time of injury, bruising and swelling, weakness in the arm, and difficulty rotating the forearm or bending the elbow. A visible bulge or "Popeye sign" in the upper arm may also occur as the bicep muscle recoils.
snippet_highlighted_words: sudden, sharp pain in the upper arm or elbow, a popping or snapping sound at the time of injury, bruising and swelling, weakness in the arm, and difficulty rotating the forearm or bending the elbow

text_blocks.snippet: Here's a more detailed look at the symptoms:

list.title: Sudden, sharp pain:
list.snippet: This is often the first symptom, felt at the site of the tear (either at the shoulder or elbow).

list.title: Popping or snapping sound:
list.snippet: This may be heard at the moment of injury if the tendon ruptures completely.

list.title: Bruising and swelling:
list.snippet: Blood vessels can be damaged when the tendon tears, leading to bruising and swelling in the upper arm, elbow, and sometimes the forearm.

list.title: Weakness:
list.snippet: A torn bicep can make it difficult to bend the elbow, rotate the forearm (supination), or lift objects.

list.title: Visible bulge:
list.snippet: The biceps muscle may bunch up or bulge in the upper arm (the "Popeye sign") due to the torn tendon no longer holding it in place.

list.title: Difficulty with arm movements:
list.snippet: Pain and weakness can make it hard to perform everyday tasks like lifting, rotating the forearm, or even holding a cup of coffee.

list.title: Cramping or spasms:
list.snippet: The biceps muscle may cramp or spasm due to the injury.

list.title: Tenderness:
list.snippet: The area around the tear may be tender to the touch.
